video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Jaylon Tyson Media Availability | 10.03.2026

quotes.speaker: Jaylon Tyson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylon Tyson on his focus during Cavs training camp
quotes.excerpt: I came in with great energy. Obviously making shots helps, and just playing within our role.
quotes.quote: I came in with great energy. Obviously making shots helps, and just playing within our role within this team what we need. Trying to make that extra effort. That's something that we harped on all summer is making that extra effort. So just trying to make that and just try to be a little bit of a vocal leader. Those are the things that I've been trying to hone in on and like I said, making shots helps.
quotes.social_post: Jaylon Tyson says his focus during Cavs training camp is on bringing great energy and being a vocal leader. He is emphasizing making the extra effort on every play.

quotes.speaker: Jaylon Tyson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylon Tyson on his physical development and diet changes
quotes.excerpt: I feel stronger, but I also feel like I'm moving better.
quotes.quote: I feel stronger, but I also feel like I'm moving better. So it's kind of like I think it had to do with my diet. I changed up my diet, got a chef. So I think that has something to do with it. It helps a lot. It helps with being able to battle down there with bigs, helps when you're going for offensive rebounds. Obviously, I love to crash and rebound and it helps on the defensive side a lot because those little bumps, they mean something now. You bump people off their line. So strength part means a lot. I think a lot of young guys don't understand how important the weight room is.
quotes.social_post: Jaylon Tyson credits a new diet and chef for his improved movement and strength. He says the physical gains are helping him battle bigs and be more effective on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Jaylon Tyson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylon Tyson on his dietary adjustments and vegetable intake
quotes.excerpt: The only thing that really changed was eating more vegetables and need more cleaner.
quotes.quote: I never had really a bad diet. I'm not really a big fast food guy, but the only thing that really changed was eating more vegetables and need more cleaner. I always eat a lot of fish, so I love eating a lot of fish, but I think the vegetable aspect and then making sure that I'm getting my smoothie intake, my smoothies and fruits, I mean, fruits and vegetables.
quotes.social_post: Jaylon Tyson explains his dietary changes, noting that he is focusing more on eating vegetables and maintaining a consistent intake of smoothies and fruits.

quotes.speaker: Jaylon Tyson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylon Tyson on Kenny Atkinson's expectations for his development
quotes.excerpt: He told me straight up, I had a great year. Obviously playoffs didn't go how I wanted.
quotes.quote: He told me straight up, he told me I had a great year. Obviously playoffs didn't go how I wanted. And me and him kind of, he gave it to me to figure out what he wanted me to work on. He said, 'Man, I love everything about what you brought to the table.' I told him, this is like a couple days after the playoff series, I took a couple days to really evaluate my season, evaluate how I thought it went. And obviously, I thought the regular season went great, but in the playoffs, I think the mental aspect took a toll on me. Being able to handle the ups and downs and not playing as much as I was used to in the regular season, I think that's something that really took a toll on me and affected my performance and ultimately affected the team.
quotes.social_post: Jaylon Tyson admits the mental aspect of the playoffs took a toll on him last season. He says struggling to handle the ups and downs of reduced playing time affected his performance.
